facts.business: Sattrix Information Security Limited is a cybersecurity solutions and services provider delivering end-to-end information security, consulting, implementation, integration, managed security, and support services to enterprises across diverse industry verticals.

auditor.name: G. K. Chokshi & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Advance to Vendors includes Rs. 1,41,40,000 paid to Mr. V.V. Satyanarayana Oduri (Satish) and Data Technophile Pvt Ltd towards an alleged government project involving forged documentation; FIR registered, matter under investigation, no provision made as management believes amount will be recovered.

key_risks: Advance to vendors of Rs. 1.41 crore involving alleged forged documentation and ongoing criminal investigation (FIR Cr. No. 67/2025) with no provision made
Rise of Agentic AI and Shadow AI risks
Identity risk and credential protection vulnerabilities
Cloud native and continuous monitoring complexities
Ransomware evolution and fragmented threat actors
Cybersecurity skills shortages and talent gaps
Interconnected risk from supply chain and third-party vulnerabilities
facts.related_party_note: Contracts or arrangements with related parties were on an arm's length basis. Details of material contracts provided in Annexure III and Form AOC-2. During the year, the Company made an investment in Sattrix Software Solutions Private Limited by acquiring 45,48,379 equity shares at ₹347 per share. The Company also holds investments in subsidiaries/overseas entities: ₹11,70,670 in Sattrix Information Security DMCC, ₹1,42,185 in Sattrix Information Security Inc., and ₹1,093 in Sattrix Information Security SDN BHD.
